mapper.sql: select o.*,ds.study_id,ds.position_id,ds.workpiece_id,ds.series_instance_uid series_uid, s.study_instance_uid study_uid,p.position_name,w.task_id from ndt_dicom_object o join ndt_dicom_series ds on ds.id=o.series_id and ds.del_flag='0' join ndt_inspection_study s on s.id=ds.study_id and s.del_flag='0' join ndt_inspection_position p on p.id=ds.position_id and p.del_flag='0' join ndt_workpiece w on w.id=p.workpiece_id and w.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: where ds.position_id=#{positionId} and o.del_flag='0' order by o.create_time,o.id
where ds.study_id=#{studyId} and ds.position_id=#{positionId} and o.del_flag='0' order by o.create_time,o.id
where o.series_id=#{seriesId} and o.object_type='ORIGINAL_IMAGE' and o.del_flag='0' limit 1
where ds.study_id=#{studyId} and ds.position_id=#{positionId} and o.object_type='ORIGINAL_IMAGE' and o.del_flag='0' limit 1
mapper.update: update ndt_dicom_object set series_id=#{seriesId},object_type=#{objectType},object_name=#{objectName},storage_type=#{storageType},orthanc_instance_id=#{orthancInstanceId},file_path=#{filePath},object_key=#{objectKey},mime_type=#{mimeType},sop_instance_uid=#{sopInstanceUid},sop_class_uid=#{sopClassUid},parameters_json=#{parametersJson},metadata_json=#{metadataJson},sha256=#{sha256},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
